task_title: QA filing: CF-242 section-mapping census cannot see a duplicate-numbered or indented section header
task_criteria: Filing-only verification tick, graded at the commit this task lands in. (1) `git show --stat HEAD` names .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl and .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl and nothing else. (2) `jq -e 'select(.id=="CF-242") | select(.status=="pending") | select((.probe|length)>0)' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` exits 0. (3) Extracting that row's probe from the COMMITTED board and running it from the repo root prints `at_column_headers=50 indented_headers=1`, then `arms_plan=49 arms_tree=49`, then `RESULT: OK`, and exits 0 — that output is the defect: two appended section spellings (a duplicate number at column 0 and an indented header) leave the mapping gate green. (4) `bash scripts/boardctl validate` prints RESULT: OK and `bash tests/selftest.sh` prints SELFTEST: PASS at that commit. The repair (making the section census a multiset over at-column headers and failing with a named row for a duplicated number or an indented header) is future work tracked by pending row CF-242 and is NOT expected at this commit; do not evaluate the fix.
